claim: Basque union ELA says Foot Locker is closing its flagship ('tienda insignia') in Centro Comercial Max Center, Barakaldo (Bizkaia), where 12 people work. ELA's agreement means no forced exits: all departures are voluntary, with severance at the 'despido improcedente' (unfair dismissal) rate.
data_point: 12 staff; voluntary exits only; severance at the unfair-dismissal rate (33 days/yr under Spanish law, which is outside knowledge)
original_quote: Cierran la tienda insignia de Foot Locker en el Centro Comercial Max Center donde trabajan 12 personas. ... Todas las salidas serán estrictamente voluntarias. Las personas que opten por la salida recibirán indemnizaciones correspondientes a un despido improcedente.
english_translation: Foot Locker's flagship store in the Max Center mall, where 12 people work, is closing. ... All departures will be strictly voluntary. Those who choose to leave will receive severance equivalent to an unfair dismissal.
verifier_note: I fetched the page; it is dated 09/02/2026 and all the quotes are present. Barakaldo appears in no baseline, primer or confirmed file. The store is also gone from the stores.footlocker.es sitemap. 'Flagship' is the union's word, and this is one 12-person store, not a collective dismissal (ERE).

claim: Since 10 Sep 2026 most new roles at the FL EMEA head office in Utrecht are fixed-term. Of 7 Utrecht corporate roles posted 10 Sep to 2 Oct 2026, 5 are marked '(T)': (T) Director Media & Lifecycle Marketing (req 71264, 09-10), (T) Associate Manager Vendor Marketing (72097, 09-16), (T) Assortment Planner (71970, 09-18), (T) Manager Performance Management & Quality (72259, 09-25) and (T) Coordinator Buying (72283, 10-02). None of the 6 Utrecht corporate roles posted 23 Jul to 25 Aug 2026 is temporary.
data_point: 5 of 7 Utrecht HQ roles posted since 10 Sep 2026 are temporary, vs 0 of 6 posted Jul-Aug 2026; 3 are stated as 6-month and 1 as a 1-year contract
original_quote: This is a temporary 6-month position. Foot Locker is the OG of sneakers. Across EMEA, we are accelerating our omnichannel transformation (req 71264); This is a temporary 1 year contract. (req 72283)
verifier_note: I re-pulled the API myself on 2026-10-07 (3,018 postings) and reproduced the 6 permanent / 5-of-7 temporary split by req ID and date. Correction: req 72283 says 'temporary 1 year contract', not 6 months; req 72097 has '(T)' in its title but no term in the text. A new '(T) HR Admin - France (Puteaux)' (72372) was posted 10-07. I did not verify the LinkedIn-only temp roles (Special Projects, Paid Social, PR). Downgraded to B because the meaning is uncertain: '(T)' roles are often leave cover, and HQ is still hiring permanent staff (Associate Manager Copy 72112, Associate Planning & Analytics 72252). Lease Admin req 71630 mentions 'termination agreements' and 'permanent break options', which is standard lease-admin wording.

claim: Per-country census of FL Europe stores from the store-locator sitemaps on 2026-10-07: Italy 154, France 142, Germany 81, UK 49, Spain 48, Netherlands 22, Belgium 15, Poland 12, Portugal 11, Czech Rep. 10, Austria 6, Luxembourg 6, Ireland 5, Hungary 4, for 565 in total (Switzerland has no locator). UK path: 59 (Drapers, 3 Dec 2025), then 51 (ScrapeHero, 7 May 2026), then 49 now.
data_point: UK 49, IE 5, DE 81, ES 48, NL 22, BE 15, AT 6; total 565 in 14 countries vs 559 company-reported at 8/1/26
original_quote: There are 51 Foot Locker stores in the United Kingdom as of May 07, 2026. (ScrapeHero)
verifier_note: I re-ran the sitemap count independently, de-duplicating by trailing store number, and matched every country except Spain (48 vs 47 claimed). ScrapeHero's 51 at 7 May 2026 (46 England, 4 Scotland, 1 NI) and Drapers' 59 are both verified. Caveat: Drapers' 59 sits next to '620 stores across 20 countries', which does not match FL Europe's 581, so its base is unclear. The cleaner like-for-like comparison is ScrapeHero 51 to 49 in 5 months (about -9%/yr annualised, still above the ~4%/yr benchmark). Brixton and Chatham are gone from the sitemap; Glasgow 78 Argyle St and Liverpool ONE are present. The locator total runs about 1% above the 559 reported count.

claim: Trade-press detail on the new Haps (NL) Europe DC: 33,000 m² including a 13,400 m² 2020 building, 15 m high, landlord Nabuurs Beheer, Vanderlande Fastpick (Adapto AS/RS) with 78,000 locations / ~700,000 units. It is only 60% full and serves ~600 European stores, versus 700+ served from Heijen. The VP Supply Chain EMEA says Heijen was built for 500 stores, not e-commerce.
data_point: DC 60% filled; ~600 stores served vs 700+ at the Heijen peak
original_quote: Dat pand in Heijen was gebouwd voor 500 winkels, niet voor e-commerce. ... zestig procent gevuld
english_translation: That building in Heijen was built for 500 stores, not for e-commerce. ... sixty percent filled
verifier_note: Article dated 2026-06-01; I confirmed the size, landlord, Vanderlande system, 60% fill, 600 vs 700+ stores and the Heijsman quote. Partly KNOWN: the baseline (10-K FY25) already has the Haps leased DC opened Sep-2025 replacing Heijen. New here: utilisation, stores served and landlord. Conflict: the 10-K says Haps is 503,000 sq ft (~46,700 m²), while Warehouse Totaal says 33,000 m². The 'overcapacity' wording describes post-startup throughput headroom and is not plainly a statement of volumes below plan.

english_translation: The streetwear retailer Foot Locker has withdrawn; the branch opened for the last time on Saturday. ... By the start of the week moving boxes were already stacked on the sales floor

claim: The Foot Locker store on Bahnhofstraße, Fulda was closing within days, with the space reportedly to be cleared by 20 May 2026. Some staff were already looking for new jobs, and the company did not answer press inquiries.
data_point: Closure ~20 May 2026; staff job-hunting, with no transfer mentioned
original_quote: Die Filiale von Foot Locker in Fulda schließt und das wohl schon bald. ... Nach unseren Informationen ist ein Teil der Mitarbeitenden bereits auf der Suche nach neuen Arbeitsstellen.
english_translation: The Foot Locker branch in Fulda is closing, and probably soon. ... According to our information some employees are already looking for new jobs.
verifier_note: Both outlets are dated 2026-05-17. Osthessen|News says the closure is not yet officially confirmed by the company, but staff confirmed it informally, and Osthessen-Zeitung confirms it. I verified the 20 May clearance date and the staff job-hunting. Not in the baseline.
